name: mousedent
description: Monorepo de MouseDent: API .NET y panel/web Angular.

scripts.build: npm run api:openapi && npm run build -w @mousedent/api-client && npm run build -w @mousedent/web
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.api:client: npm run api:openapi && npm run build -w @mousedent/api-client
scripts.db:update: dotnet ef database update --project apps/api/src/MouseDent.Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/MouseDent.Infrastructure
scripts.db:migration: dotnet ef migrations add --project apps/api/src/MouseDent.Infrastructure --startup-project apps/api/src/MouseDent.Infrastructure --output-dir Persistence/Migrations
